answer: Yes, a North Carolina store can buy a car registered in Virginia, but you'll need to do two things first. First, North Carolina stores need the registration to be current on the day of the sale, so renew your Virginia registration before your appointment and bring the registration Virginia issued. Second, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before a North Carolina store can buy it. Because your plates are from Virginia, take them off at the sale and keep them.
